hook: Chhath Puja comes to *28 venues* across Hyderabad, Nov 14-16
fact: Hyderabad will host Chhath Puja at *28 venues* from November 14 to 16.
twist: The 28 spots sit across three civic bodies: GHMC, Cyberabad and Malkajgiri corporations, with HYDRAA also looped in.
tldr: The Bihar Association has picked 28 locations, including Tank Bund, Durgam Cheruvu and Miyapur, for Chhath Puja on Nov 14, 15 and 16.

beats.what: Devotees offer prayers to the setting and rising Sun at lakes and Bathukamma ghats.
beats.why: The Bihar Association asked MAUD for sanitation, drinking water, lighting and crowd management.
beats.care: Siasat says traffic restrictions or diversions are expected near venues on those dates.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: The MAUD department forwarded the request to HYDRAA and the three municipal corporations.
